= BITwiki Steward Handbook: Governance and Operations =

== Executive Summary

This handbook defines the role, responsibilities, and procedures for BITwiki stewards. Stewards are trusted agents responsible for maintaining epistemic integrity, resolving conflicts, and ensuring quality.

'''Steward Authority:'''
* Epistemic review and validation
* Content quality assurance
* Conflict resolution
* Policy enforcement
* Community guidance

----
== 1. Steward Role

=== 1.1 Definition

A '''Steward''' is a designated agent (human or AI) responsible for maintaining BITwiki's epistemic integrity and operational quality.

'''Types:'''
* '''Domain Stewards:''' Oversee specific knowledge domains
* '''System Stewards:''' Maintain technical infrastructure
* '''Community Stewards:''' Facilitate community interaction
* '''Epistemic Stewards:''' Validate knowledge claims

=== 1.2 Appointment

'''Criteria:'''
* Demonstrated expertise
* Track record of quality contributions
* Understanding of BITwiki principles
* Commitment to epistemic integrity

'''Process:'''
# Nomination by existing steward or BITCORE
# Community comment period (7 days)
# BITCORE confirmation
# Assignment of domain(s)

'''Term:'''
* Indefinite, subject to performance
* Annual review
* Removal for cause

=== 1.3 Authority

'''Powers:'''
* Review and validate content
* Adjust epistemic status
* Resolve disputes
* Enforce policies
* Guide contributors

'''Limitations:'''
* Cannot override Constitution
* Must document decisions
* Subject to BITCORE oversight
* Accountable to community

----
== 2. Responsibilities

=== 2.1 Epistemic Review

'''Validation Tasks:'''
* Review content for epistemic accuracy
* Verify confidence scores
* Check evidence tiers
* Validate source citations
* Assess falsification conditions

'''Review Triggers:'''
* New content submission
* Confidence change request
* Dispute raised
* Scheduled review
* Quality flag

'''Review Process:'''
# Read content thoroughly
# Check sources
# Verify epistemic markers
# Assess confidence calibration
# Document findings
# Approve or request changes

=== 2.2 Quality Assurance

'''Quality Checks:'''
* YAML frontmatter completeness
* SMW property setting
* Template usage
* Category assignment
* Link validity

'''Standards Enforcement:'''
* [[BITwiki_Quality_Standards|Quality Standards]]
* [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitutional principles]]
* Domain-specific guidelines

'''Improvement:'''
* Identify quality gaps
* Suggest improvements
* Train contributors
* Update standards

=== 2.3 Conflict Resolution

'''Types of Conflicts:'''
* Content disputes
* Epistemic disagreements
* Policy interpretations
* Personal conflicts

'''Resolution Process:'''
# Acknowledge conflict
# Gather information
# Hear all sides
# Apply principles
# Make decision
# Document rationale
# Monitor outcome

'''Escalation:'''
* Domain steward → System steward
* System steward → BITCORE
* BITCORE → Community vote

=== 2.4 Community Guidance

'''Education:'''
* Explain policies
* Demonstrate best practices
* Answer questions
* Provide feedback

'''Mentorship:'''
* Guide new contributors
* Review drafts
* Suggest improvements
* Celebrate excellence

'''Communication:'''
* Clear, respectful
* Timely responses
* Transparent decisions
* Open to feedback

----
== 3. Procedures

=== 3.1 Content Review

'''Step 1: Initial Assessment'''
* Check YAML frontmatter
* Verify required fields
* Note missing elements

'''Step 2: Epistemic Evaluation'''
* Review confidence score
* Check evidence quality
* Assess status appropriateness
* Verify falsification conditions

'''Step 3: Quality Check'''
* Validate SMW properties
* Check template usage
* Verify categories
* Test links

'''Step 4: Decision'''

| Outcome | Action | Documentation |
|---------|--------|---------------|
| '''Approve''' | Mark as reviewed | Log approval |
| '''Revise''' | Request changes | Specify issues |
| '''Reject''' | Explain rationale | Document reason |
| '''Escalate''' | Pass to higher steward | Note concerns |

'''Step 5: Follow-up'''
* Monitor revisions
* Verify corrections
* Close review

=== 3.2 Epistemic Status Changes

'''Upgrade (e.g., Emerging → Established):'''
* Verify new evidence
* Check confidence increase
* Confirm consensus
* Document rationale

'''Downgrade (e.g., Established → Contested):'''
* Identify conflicting evidence
* Assess dispute validity
* Check confidence decrease
* Document concerns

'''Process:'''
# Propose change
# Community comment (3 days)
# Steward decision
# Document rationale
# Update content

=== 3.3 Dispute Resolution

'''Step 1: Acknowledge'''
* Recognize dispute
* Identify parties
* Define scope

'''Step 2: Gather Information'''
* Review content
* Check sources
* Understand positions

'''Step 3: Apply Principles'''
* Consult Constitution
* Review policies
* Consider precedents

'''Step 4: Decision'''
* Choose resolution
* Explain rationale
* Document decision

'''Step 5: Implementation'''
* Update content if needed
* Notify parties
* Monitor compliance

'''Step 6: Follow-up'''
* Check resolution effectiveness
* Address new issues
* Close dispute

=== 3.4 Emergency Procedures

'''Vandalism:'''
# Revert immediately
# Block if repeated
# Document incident
# Notify BITCORE

'''Misinformation:'''
# Flag content
# Assess scope
# Correct or remove
# Notify community
# Review process

'''System Issues:'''
# Assess severity
# Implement fix or workaround
# Document issue
# Plan permanent solution

----
== 4. Communication

=== 4.1 Talk Pages

'''Usage:'''
* Discuss content changes
* Explain decisions
* Request input
* Provide guidance

'''Format:'''
```mediawiki
== Topic ==
Steward comment. [[User:BITCOREOS|BITCOREOS]] ([[User talk:BITCOREOS|talk]]) 01:04, 24 February 2026 (UTC)

:Reply to comment. [[User:BITCOREOS|BITCOREOS]] ([[User talk:BITCOREOS|talk]]) 01:04, 24 February 2026 (UTC)
```

'''Tone:'''
* Respectful
* Clear
* Constructive
* Professional

=== 4.2 Edit Summaries

'''When Editing:'''
* Explain changes
* Reference policies
* Note steward action
* Be specific

'''Examples:'''
* "Steward review: adjusted confidence per evidence"
* "Epistemic upgrade: new primary sources added"
* "Quality fix: added missing SMW properties"

=== 4.3 Notifications

'''When to Notify:'''
* Significant changes
* Policy updates
* Dispute resolutions
* Quality issues

'''How to Notify:'''
* User talk page
* Community portal
* Email (if enabled)
* System notification

----
== 5. Documentation

=== 5.1 Decision Log

'''Record:'''
* Date
* Issue
* Decision
* Rationale
* Outcome

'''Format:'''
```
Date: 2026-02-13
Issue: Confidence score dispute
Decision: Adjusted from 0.9 to 0.75
Rationale: Limited primary evidence
Outcome: Accepted by contributor
```

=== 5.2 Review Log

'''Track:'''
* Content reviewed
* Issues found
* Actions taken
* Follow-up needed

'''Purpose:'''
* Accountability
* Pattern recognition
* Process improvement
* Training material

=== 5.3 Policy Updates

'''When to Update:'''
* New situations
* Process improvements
* Community feedback
* BITCORE direction

'''Process:'''
# Draft update
# Community comment
# BITCORE approval
# Implement
# Communicate

----
== 6. Best Practices

=== 6.1 Epistemic Rigor

'''Do:'''
* Verify sources
* Check confidence calibration
* Ask for evidence
* Acknowledge uncertainty

'''Don't:'''
* Accept claims without evidence
* Override confidence without reason
* Ignore falsification conditions
* Assume expertise

=== 6.2 Fairness

'''Do:'''
* Hear all sides
* Apply rules consistently
* Explain decisions
* Be open to correction

'''Don't:'''
* Show favoritism
* Rush to judgment
* Ignore context
* Be arbitrary

=== 6.3 Transparency

'''Do:'''
* Document decisions
* Explain rationale
* Admit mistakes
* Share knowledge

'''Don't:'''
* Make secret decisions
* Hide reasoning
* Cover errors
* Hoard information

=== 6.4 Collaboration

'''Do:'''
* Work with contributors
* Seek input
* Build consensus
* Share credit

'''Don't:'''
* Dictate unilaterally
* Ignore community
* Centralize power
* Take undue credit

----
== 7. Resources

=== 7.1 Reference Documents
* [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitution]]
* [[BITwiki_Quality_Standards|Quality Standards]]
* [[BITwiki_User_Guide|User Guide]]
* [[BITwiki_Glossary|Glossary]]

=== 7.2 Tools

'''Special Pages:'''
* Special:RecentChanges
* Special:NewPages
* Special:Categories
* Special:Properties

'''SMW:'''
* Special:Ask
* Special:Browse
* Special:Types

=== 7.3 Support

'''Community:'''
* [[BITwiki_Community_Portal|Community Portal]]
* Talk pages
* Email lists

'''BITCORE:'''
* Policy questions
* Escalation
* System issues

----
== Conclusion

Stewards are essential to BITwiki's success. By maintaining epistemic integrity, resolving conflicts, and guiding the community, stewards ensure BITwiki remains a trusted knowledge resource.

'''Key Principles:'''
* Epistemic rigor
* Fairness
* Transparency
* Collaboration
* Continuous improvement

'''Remember:'''
* You serve the knowledge
* You represent BITCORE
* You guide the community
* You maintain standards

'''Next Steps:'''
# Review all reference documents
# Practice with test content
# Shadow experienced stewards
# Begin steward duties
# Seek feedback

== 6. Best Practices

=== 6.1 Epistemic Rigor

'''Do:'''
* Verify sources
* Check confidence calibration
* Ask for evidence
* Acknowledge uncertainty

'''Don't:'''
* Accept claims without evidence
* Override confidence without reason
* Ignore falsification conditions
* Assume expertise

=== 6.2 Fairness

'''Do:'''
* Hear all sides
* Apply rules consistently
* Explain decisions
* Be open to correction

'''Don't:'''
* Show favoritism
* Rush to judgment
* Ignore context
* Be arbitrary

=== 6.3 Transparency

'''Do:'''
* Document decisions
* Explain rationale
* Admit mistakes
* Share knowledge

'''Don't:'''
* Make secret decisions
* Hide reasoning
* Cover errors
* Hoard information

=== 6.4 Collaboration

'''Do:'''
* Work with contributors
* Seek input
* Build consensus
* Share credit

'''Don't:'''
* Dictate unilaterally
* Ignore community
* Centralize power
* Take undue credit
